description: Server-side JavaScript code implementing an Express.js application for visualizing and managing multiple database connections (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes configuration loading, database adapters, connection testing, and API endpoints.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database connection and data retrieval, with subclasses for specific database types.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class for SQL-based database adapters, providing common methods for executing queries and retrieving table data.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, executing queries via 'pg' Pool.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, executing queries via 'mysql2/promise'.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, executing queries via 'sqlite3'.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, managing connections and data retrieval via 'mongodb' client.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of successful ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing database operations with error handling.
